scope: Interruptible Help, faster keyboard speech, and browser menus, bookmarks, history and resume.

topics.title: Browser menu and bookmarks
details: Web browser opens a menu with Search or type address, Go to bookmark, New bookmark, Delete bookmark, Rename bookmark, Go back, Go forward and Web history. Bookmark actions use saved lists, arrows, Home/End, Enter, first-letter and multiple-letter navigation. New bookmark and Rename bookmark accept a spoken name or typed name followed by Enter. Existing favorites are preserved.

Web history retains up to 200 recent secure page addresses across restarts. Alt Left and Alt Right navigate back and forward directly from pages. Escape from page reading opens the browser menu; with Keep browser window open on, Resume where you left off restores the retained page and reading position.

topics.title: Help speech interruption
details: Opening Help and moving between Help topics, subtopics or reading positions interrupts previous speech before new feedback. The shared handler covers Help opened from Word processor, Email, Web browser, Notepad and other activities. Help navigation uses responsive local speech.

topics.title: Keyboard speech responsiveness
details: Queued keyboard actions run before periodic browser page checks. Background checks wait briefly during active key navigation; quick-key visual scrolling occurs after spoken feedback is queued. These changes cover every supported browser.

topics.title: Updated learning materials
details: The browser tutorial, onboard Help, all six manual formats and all six versioned release-note formats describe the new menu, bookmark management, Web history and resume behavior.
